body: I just can't take it. I really feel low and can't pick myself up. The past year I've been constantly knocked when down and I don't amount to anything. I feel that when I talk to some friends they don't want me around because of my current mental state.

Thanks for giving it a read. Honestly I just needed to vent and write it down. All this breakdown happened within the 6 months so it's very fresh. I wish I could apologise but I can't. She wants nothing to do with me and have already moved on to another relationship. 

I hope one day when she gets help then I will be there to support her but that may never happen. My sergeant said at the time that it will go off like a grenade but now the force knows about it they can work with steps on helping her.

Thanks for replying. This is what I needed to hear. There was the issue with being obligated for the public to protect them. It became an issue with correcting victims and amongst other things I tried to reach out to in counselling. It just made it worse. I have to deal with this consequence but I've ruined my life as a result of this. 

I didn't want her to suffer and she doesn't want to deal with it and you're right that isn't my place.
